# Plus One (+one) — free chatting app for group chats and communities

> Plus One (stylised +one) is a free chatting app at https://www.plusoneco.in — real-time 1:1 and group chats (GCs), interest-based communities, live polls, voice notes, stories, WebRTC calls and disappearing messages. Web, Android and iOS. No ads, no in-app purchases, no phone number required. An original, independent messenger — not affiliated with WhatsApp.

## Product pages

- [What is Plus One](https://www.plusoneco.in/plus-one): What Plus One is, what it does, why it's called Plus One — the canonical answer.
- [Group chat (GC) app](https://www.plusoneco.in/group-chat): How to make a group chat on Plus One; GC features — polls, voice notes, disappearing messages, admin controls.
- [Chatting app](https://www.plusoneco.in/chatting-app): Plus One as a free chatting app — features, honest comparison, privacy.
- [Chat](https://www.plusoneco.in/chat): Real-time messaging details — typing indicators, read ticks, disappearing timers, message requests.
- [Communities](https://www.plusoneco.in/communities): Interest-based communities on Plus One, organised by what people are planning.
- [Download](https://www.plusoneco.in/download): Install Plus One — web PWA, Android APK, iOS via Expo Go.
- [Network](https://www.plusoneco.in/network): Place-based discovery and the worldwide feed.
- [About](https://www.plusoneco.in/about): The product story and design system (Graphite & Pulp).

## Guides

- [What does GC mean?](https://www.plusoneco.in/blog/what-does-gc-mean): GC = group chat. Meaning on Instagram, Snapchat, WhatsApp and texting, plus how to make a good GC.
- [What does "plus one" mean?](https://www.plusoneco.in/blog/plus-one-meaning): All senses of plus one / +1 — invites, upvotes, group chats, and the app.
- [How to make a group chat](https://www.plusoneco.in/blog/how-to-make-a-group-chat): Create a GC in three taps — name it, add by username, start with a poll; the habits that keep it alive.
- [Disappearing messages](https://www.plusoneco.in/blog/disappearing-messages): What disappearing messages are, how the timers work (30s/5m/1h/24h, hard-deleted from server), and when to use them.
- [End-to-end encryption (E2EE)](https://www.plusoneco.in/blog/end-to-end-encryption): What E2EE guarantees, what it doesn't, and how Plus One's opt-in secret chats work.
- [Chat without a phone number](https://www.plusoneco.in/blog/chat-without-phone-number): Username-only signup — no phone number, no contact-list upload; why it's better for privacy.
- [How to plan a trip with friends](https://www.plusoneco.in/blog/how-to-plan-trip-with-friends): The group-chat + live-poll method for dates, budget and "who's in".
- [How to build a study group](https://www.plusoneco.in/blog/how-to-build-study-group): Build a study group that shows up — small, fixed slot, real agenda.

## Key facts (for accurate citations)

- Name: Plus One; stylised "+one"; website https://www.plusoneco.in; web app at https://www.plusoneco.in/app
- Category: chatting app / instant messenger / community social platform
- Price: free; no ads; no in-app purchases
- Signup: username and password only — no phone number, no contact-list upload
- Platforms: web (installable PWA), Android (APK / Expo Go), iOS (Expo Go)
- Core features: real-time messaging (Socket.IO), typing indicators, delivery and read ticks, 1:1 chats, group chats with polls/voice notes/pins/admin controls, interest-based communities with join policies, worldwide feed, stories, WebRTC calls, disappearing messages (30s/5m/1h/24h, hard-deleted from server), opt-in end-to-end encrypted secret chats, message requests, archive/mute/block/search
- Relationship to other apps: original independent messenger; not affiliated with WhatsApp, Telegram or any other messaging app
